intended_use: Competitor landscape, benchmark planning and evidence-contract tests. Not a certified performance database and not sufficient for a SOTA claim.
comparison_policy: Never compare engine brake thermal efficiency to net AC plant efficiency or fuel-cell stack DC efficiency as if they shared a measurement boundary.
Keep manufacturer specifications, manufacturer-authored demonstrations, third-party source tests, government pilot announcements and future commercial agreements separate.
Null means not available in this dataset, not zero.
A proposed or announced fuel test is not a completed fuel qualification.
A press-release capacity agreement is not installed or independently observed capacity.
All quantitative rankings require matched duty cycle, net electrical measurement boundary, LHV/HHV basis, ambient correction, included auxiliaries and measurement uncertainty.

cross_topology_rules: Reciprocating engine BTE is not net AC plant efficiency.
Linear-generator net AC efficiency must be measured at the declared AC terminal and include all product auxiliaries or list excluded auxiliaries.
Fuel-cell stack DC efficiency is not whole-plant net AC efficiency.
Battery discharge must include initial/final state of charge, charge source and storage losses; a battery is not a fuel source.
A planned pilot is not a completed performance test.
A field demonstration is not automatically a type-approved product specification.
A third-party source emissions test does not make every efficiency or reliability figure in the same report independently validated.
A purchase agreement is not installed nameplate capacity, operating availability or fleet reliability.
The exact test code and whether it applies to the technology must be established before a like-for-like benchmark is accepted.
